# owasp-api-2023

OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023): object-level authorization, broken authentication, property-level exposure, rate limiting and the rest of the list every SECURITY finding cites.

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-SEC-001` | critical | Object-level authorization on every ID-bearing request (BOLA) |
| `AF-SEC-002` | high | Authentication is verified per operation, not per service |
| `AF-SEC-003` | high | Response fields are filtered by the caller's authority |
| `AF-SEC-004` | high | Resource consumption is bounded (rate limits, payload, timeouts) |
| `AF-SEC-005` | critical | Function-level authorization on admin and internal paths (BFLA) |
| `AF-SEC-006` | high | Server-side fetches are allow-listed (SSRF) |
| `AF-SEC-007` | medium | API inventory is managed — no shadow or zombie versions |
| `AF-SEC-008` | medium | Secrets and identifiers stay out of URLs |
